HORSE SCHOOL · 30 SECONDS

One button.
One leg.

Tap the colored buttons to move each leg. On a keyboard, use Q W O P.

For a steady trot, alternate diagonal legs: back left → front right → back right → front left. Start with about three taps a second.

Spamming one leg tips you over. Stop too long and your horse gives up. Get as far as you can, then challenge someone to beat you.
